answer: Because selection is random and the quill seed is unrevealed until close, anyone cannot dodge the sample, so colluding to grade clones' junk is a mesa gamble with a negative expected value. The willow log keeps the sampled set and the penalty so the deterrent is verifiable. A random sample of settled verdicts is re-graded by an independent panel each epoch, and a divergence found on re-check burns the original grader 21% of its standing plus a seat ban.
